card.name: Start number of a numeric range
card.fires_on: The last digit of the first number in a range, just before a dash or the word 'to' that leads into the end number. It appears in year ranges, page ranges, day ranges and dose bands.

modes.label: Year and page ranges
modes.description: The final digit of a starting year or page number before a hyphen and the end number.

modes.label: Day, cycle and dose ranges
modes.description: The starting number in a dosing schedule range such as days or cycles, before 'to' or 'and'.
modes.example: 6: 50 mg twice a day. Days <<7>> to 9: 100

card.writes: It promotes range-linking tokens such as 到, 至, đến and the en dash, so a range connector comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the first number of a range, such as 2005 in 2005-2009 or Days 2 in Days 2 to 5, and prepares for the 'to' or dash that follows.
